summary: Backend testing complete - All 94 tests passed (81 existing + 13 new iteration 6 tests). Comprehensive testing of guest player functionality: editors can manually add guests to lineups, guests get synthetic IDs, stats/league points only update for registered users, validation enforced.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ GuestRef model accepts name (1-40 chars) and optional shirt_number (1-99)
✅ LineupOverrideIn accepts Union[str, GuestRef] for team_a, team_b, team_c, reserves
✅ PUT /api/matches/{id}/lineup hydrate() function handles both user_ids (strings) and guest objects
✅ Guests get synthetic user_ids prefixed with 'guest:' followed by UUID
✅ Guests have is_guest=true, vote='guest', rating=0, profile_picture=null, preferred_position=null
✅ Registered users who didn't vote are hydrated from users collection with vote defaulting to 'yes'
✅ Registered users who voted have their original vote preserved in lineup
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/result skips guests when updating goals/assists/matches_played (checks user_id.startswith('guest:'))
✅ Editing match result with guests: only real users' stats are reverted and re-applied
✅ DELETE /api/matches/{id} with guests: only real users' stats are reverted
✅ League match result with guests: _apply_league_delta skips guests when awarding league points
✅ Duplicate detection works for registered user_ids (400 error), but multiple guests with same name allowed (each gets unique synthetic ID)
✅ Team size caps enforced when mixing registered users and guests
✅ Guest name validation: 1-40 characters (422 error if empty or >40)
✅ Guest shirt_number validation: 1-99 or null (422 error if 0 or >99)
✅ No regressions - all 81 existing tests still pass
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 adds guest player support: (1) PUT /api/matches/{id}/lineup now accepts Union[str, GuestRef] per team, where GuestRef = {name: str (1-40), shirt_number: int? (1-99)}. (2) Guests get synthetic IDs 'guest:<uuid>' on server. (3) Guests carry is_guest=true and vote='guest' in hydrated lineup. (4) record_result and _apply_league_delta skip any user_id starting with 'guest:' when writing DB stats. (5) Duplicate detection only applies to registered users; multiple guests with same name allowed. (6) Team size caps enforced for mixed entries. All features working correctly with proper validation.

verified_requirements: ✅ PUT /api/matches/{id}/lineup accepts mixed entries: string user_ids AND guest objects {name, shirt_number} in same team array
✅ Guest entries get synthetic user_ids prefixed with 'guest:' in stored lineup
✅ Guest entries have is_guest=true, vote='guest', rating=0, and include provided name and shirt_number
✅ Adding registered user who didn't vote works - hydrated from users collection (vote defaults to 'yes')
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/result with mix of real user stats and guest user stats - only real users get goals/assists/matches_played incremented; guests safely ignored (no 500, no DB write)
✅ Editing match result with guests safely reverts registered user stats only (guest deltas are no-ops, no error)
✅ DELETE /api/matches/{id} for played match with guests reverts real users' stats and succeeds with ok:true
✅ League match result with guests awards league points only to registered users in winning team (guests skipped)
✅ Duplicate detection works for registered user_ids across teams (400 error); multiple guests with same name allowed (each gets unique synthetic id)
✅ Team size caps enforced when mixing users and guests
✅ No regressions - previous 81 tests still pass (auth, forgot-password, match CRUD, voting, lineup algorithm, league, timer, lineup override with user_ids only)
